settings.title: How to Use
settings.richtext:
Step 1:
Remove cap

Step 2:
Twist bottom of bottle until formula begins to appear from perforated cap (Don’t overtwist! A little goes a long way)

Step 3:
Apply formula directly on underarm

For best results, keep deodorant at room temperature (68°F to 77°F / 20°C to 25°C)

settings.title: Step 1
settings.description: Complete your skincare routine. We recommend priming your skin with a pump of our Deep Dive Hydrator.

settings.title: Step 2
settings.description: Apply Daily Defender SPF30 Sunscreen in the morning before you go outside, or 15 minutes before going in the sun, and as the final step in your daily skincare routine. Apply one pump amount or more of our Daily Defender SPF30 Sunscreen into hands and gently rub onto face, neck, chest and body if applicable.

settings.title: Step 3
settings.description: Reapply after 40 min of swimming or sweating, immediately after towel drying and at least every 2 hours when exposed to the sun.

settings.text:
• Highly effective odor-absorbing agent that tackles unwanted smells at the source—without interfering with your skin’s natural processes.
  • Unlike harsh antibacterial ingredients, it neutralizes odor molecules without disrupting the delicate skin microbiome, keeping your underarms balanced, comfortable, and fresh.
  • Derived from castor oil, this gentle but powerful ingredient works by trapping odor compounds, making it a smart choice for those seeking clean, effective deodorant solutions.

• Sinodor works by specifically targeting and binding to malodor molecules, effectively neutralizing unwanted smells at the source.
  • Instead of masking odor, it removes it entirely—creating a balanced environment where good bacteria can thrive and support a healthy skin microbiome.
  • This smart, science-backed deodorizing ingredient makes it possible to stay fresh without compromising your skin’s natural ecosystem.

• SMA’RT TEC is an advanced deodorizing technology that disrupts the enzyme activity responsible for turning sweat into body odor.
  • By stopping malodor formation at the source, it keeps you feeling fresh—without the need to block sweat or disturb your skin’s natural balance.

settings.title: YOUR SWEAT SMELLS GOOD
settings.description: Ingredients formulated to balance your skin’s microbiome so odor-causing bacteria are kept at bay, while the good bacteria that keep your skin healthy are left to thrive.

settings.title: I am blown away...
settings.review: by the effectiveness of this product. Yeah, I sweat like crazy between ultra endurance training and menopausal hot flashes, but baby I do NOT smell. I can skip a day and still not offend. I will stick with this as long as I can get it, love it so much!
settings.name: Gwenn C.

settings.title: Works & Smells Great
settings.review: These products are great.  Both of them smell good, last all day, and are kind to my skin.  I have to be careful what I use and these deodorants haven't caused a rash like many others have.
settings.name: Charles G

settings.title: Another great FN product.
settings.review: Love the scent and most importantly it works. Great deodorant.
settings.name: Douglas D.

settings.title: The new go-to
settings.review: This is my new go-to deodorant - it feels so nice on (dry but soft/moisturizing), it’s a really nice scent (manly-ish but still unisex) and really stands up to stinky pits. My husband loves it too!!
settings.name: Sandra N

settings.title: This product works!
settings.review: I have tried every natural deodorant I could get my hands on over the past few years. Most do little to nothing - and some are outright irritating. This products works - better even than I expected. The scent (I have bergamot) is mild and pleasant, the product effectively prevents odor, and even with a 40 min HIIT workout at my gym it kept my sweat in check.
settings.name: Jacqueline J
